chunks: Muḥammad ibn Aḥmad ibn Yaḥyā narrated this hadith from al-Ḥasan ibn al-Ḥusayn al-Luʾluʾī, from Abū Dāwūd al-Munshid, from Jaʿfar ibn Muḥammad, from Yūnus, from Ḥammād ibn ʿĪsā.

key_terms.اللُّؤْلُؤِيِّ: the nisbah of al-Ḥasan ibn al-Ḥusayn al-Luʾluʾī in this sanad/isnad
key_terms.الْمُنْشِدِ: the nisbah/title of Abū Dāwūd in this sanad/isnad
key_terms.رَوَى: narrated; transmitted a report through a sanad/isnad
key_terms.مِثْلَهُ: the same as the previous report in wording or meaning

ai.seo_question: What does "مِثْلَهُ" mean in a hadith chain entry in Tahdhib al-Ahkam?
ai.summary: This entry gives an alternative sanad/isnad for the same hadith mentioned previously, indicating that the report is transmitted through another chain. Its significance lies in hadith transmission and corroboration rather than in presenting a new matn here.
